model_status: theoretical research contracts; no tradable CUSIP option or firm premium quote
underlier: synthetic fixed-maturity US Treasury zero-coupon price per $1 face, marked to Federal Reserve Svensson fitted nominal zero curve; not 912803HY2 transaction history
underlier_cusip_proxy_only: 912803HY2 is principal STRIP due 2046-08-15 per 2026-08 MSPD; target horizon from 2026-09-17 is 2046-09-17, 33 days later. Index path remains curve proxy.
exercise: European cash settlement at expiry; payoff = face_notional * max(strike - zero_price_at_expiry,0), settlement cash reinvested in VUSXX proxy
strike_policy: Each put strike is 80% of the inception forward price for the corresponding expiry, so the buffer is 20% against that expiry's curve-implied forward mark.
pricing: Black-76 put on bond forward; discount and forward derived from Svensson curve; volatility is trailing 5-year realized log-vol of the same fixed maturity zero-price proxy, clipped 1%-150%.
20y_terminal_put_expiry_not_added: No 20Y put is purchased because the underlying fixed-maturity zero pays par at that horizon; 5/10/15-year staged expiry puts cover interim mark-to-market only.
